title: Wendell and the Horizon
author: Ansel Ravensworth
blurb: Orsen Eriksen, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
